I fixed the totals in the quarterly export and committed it as `665f28c`. All 9 tests pass.

The fix is in `src/orders-web/quarterly_export.py`. The total column now uses `{total:.2f}`, the same two-decimal formatting `csv_export.py` already uses. I added a test in `tests/test_orders_web.py` that checks `[0.1, 0.2]` comes out as `0.30`.

- **Uncommitted changes are untouched.** The README edit and the untracked `notes/` folder were not part of this commit.
